title: Causal Inference & Advanced Experimentation
description: Master the techniques that go beyond standard A/B tests: choose between difference-in-differences, regression discontinuity, and instrumental variables when randomization is impossible, design switchback and geo experiments for marketplace settings with spillover, decide when a multi-armed bandit beats a fixed allocation test, and reason about Bayesian sequential testing without inflating false positive rates.
outcomes: You'll choose between DiD, RDD, and IV based on the structure of the data-generating process, design a switchback experiment with an appropriate carryover washout period, explain why a multi-armed bandit minimises regret but inflates false positive risk compared to a fixed A/B test, apply Bayesian sequential testing without the optional stopping problem, and construct a long-term holdout to measure cannibalization from a launched feature.
